product.title: XtremeAir PX04-I42, 42" wide, LED lights, Both Side accessible Control, Swing-able Flat Filters, 1.0mm Non-Magnetic Stainless Steel Seamless Body, Island Mount Range Hood

reviews.text:
Really disappointed with my hood. I picked this hood because of the baffle filters which are suppose to provide superior oil catchment while looking the best.

After my first month i took out the filters to clean and noticed my oil catchment tray was empty i thought it odd since there would normally be something in there after a month of use. The filters were dirty though so i cleaned them and replaced them. Well after a few more months my vent hood is now leaking oil from the edges. The oil tray continues to be empty every time i check but now there's small puddles of oil on my counter top every few days. I contacted extreme air but they were no help saying that i need to switch it on before i cook and leave it on after (which i was already doing using the auto-shutoff feature)

In addition to the leaking oil i find the LED lights not as bright as the regular halogen lights i had on my old hood. The speed setting needs more range.

On the bright side it does look nice and i've had a few people comment on it.

reviews.text:
This freezer works well for me so far. I bought it primarily because it would fit in the only space we had available. The only slight negative is that we have to set the temperature pretty near the max in order to get the temperature below freezing. It is relatively quiet-although I can tell it is running if the house is quiet.
So far there has been very little ice build up.

The Would be Queen.

20/8/22
This book had me so engrossed and so angry . Then I realized, it’s just a book. Such is the masterful storytelling skills of Debra. You get so hooked and forget it’s makebelieve.

I’ll try not to give any spoilers but this is Dreya’s story. Full of Magic , mayhem, romance ,but compulsively addictive.
Why was I angry. Because it s a story of how a family can manipulate someone’s life and future and it’s all for the right reasons, of course. It also shows the courage that is sometimes required just to cope with life.
But there comes a point when enough is enough.
There is one chapter describing a love scene but , for once, it was done tastefully and with tenderness. I do hate it when an author feels that they have to be so graphic. So well done Debra.
There is plenty of action and it’s one of those books that you can’t read quick enough but you try to slow down at the end because it’s so good.
I could gush all day. It was SO worth a read. I thoroughly enjoyed it and recommend for anyone else to enjoy.
